observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for a 403 Forbidden response, distinguishing it from an in-body authentication failure. The comment explains that a monitor-specific API key can result in a 403 on certain endpoints, bypassing the standard auth error check.
observations.code_quote: "403 Client Error: Forbidden for url: https://api.uptimerobot.com": "Your UptimeRobot API key doesn't have permission to sync this table. Monitor-specific API keys only grant access to a single monitor, so alert contacts, maintenance windows, and status pages won't sync with one. Reconnect with a full-account read-only API key under Integrations & API in your UptimeRobot dashboard.",
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a credential failure detection for UptimeRobot warehouse ingestion, preventing retry loops when the API key lacks permission for a specific resource.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for the `error_message_matches` utility, which is used to perform the actual matching of error messages against the list of non-retryable errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the implementation of credential failure detection from a simple substring check to a dedicated utility, though the utility's implementation is not shown.

observations.behavior: Changes the test for credential failures from a substring check to a call to the new `error_message_matches` utility, and expands the test cases to include 403 Forbidden errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds test coverage for the new credential failure detection, including cases where the API returns a 403 Forbidden status instead of an in-body error.
